pages.title: First Automated Block
pages.text: Frame a compooper from seven mossy cobblestone slabs. It is the first step toward automating the poop cycle.

pages.title: Composting
pages.text: Feed compostable items into the compooper, such as poop, poop blocks, or leaves.$(br2)Each item has a chance to raise the compost level. When full, right-click to collect a sapling poop ball.

pages.title: Collecting and Distilling
pages.text: Right-click a toilet while holding a compooper: default toilets give a urine compooper, while lava toilets give a lava compooper and clear the toilet's lava.$(br2)Place a urine compooper above a lit campfire to distill it into a water compooper.$(br2)Take out the water and lava buckets, then let them touch to make cobblestone.
